items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:45 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:47 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider five items: one solicitor-client privilege matter, two land acquistion matters; one personal matter about an identifiable individual and position/plan or instruction to be applied to negotiations ; and, one matter having third-party information supplied in confidence to the municipality as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (b) (c) (f) (i) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
